title: Celery Root Remoulade (Celeri Remoulade) - David Lebovitz
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 teaspoon of sea salt (plus more, to taste)
ldInstructionsRaw: Mix together the mayonnaise, mustard, 1 teaspoon of salt, lemon juice, and a few grinds of black pepper.
Peel the celery root and grate it coarsely.
Mix the dressing with the celery root and taste, adding additional salt, pepper, mustard, and lemon juice, to taste.
htmlIngredientLines: 1 teaspoon of sea salt, plus more, to taste
